sentences.text: The One Time Cash Incentive for Labourers in the Construction Industry (OTCILD-SW) scheme aims to provide financial assistance to workers in the construction sector.
The primary objective is to support construction workers who have been adversely affected by economic disruptions.
The scheme offers a one-time cash incentive to eligible construction workers to help them meet their basic needs.
Eligibility criteria include being a registered construction worker under the Building and Other Construction Workers (BOCW) Act.
Applicants must provide proof of their registration and identity to qualify for the assistance.
The application process typically involves submitting an online application along with required documents.
The timeline for disbursement of funds is determined by the implementing agency after the application is processed.
The scheme is implemented by the Ministry of Labour and Employment in collaboration with state governments.
Additional details regarding the specific amount of assistance and application deadlines may vary by state.
